title: At The Edge Of The World

pkg.confirmedTitle: At The Edge Of The World
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, warm and soft atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
On days that ache and slowly fade
your quiet smile stayed with me
a gentle word, a warmer hand
small lights inside my heart

Even through the drifting wind
your scent still finds its way to me

[Chorus]
I'll hold you with a wider heart
every piece of you inside
even on the days we shake
this feeling stays the same

I'll gather every fragile part
and keep it close with mine
in the quiet of this love
I'll keep you in my arms

[Verse 2]
When both our voices fall to tears
I'll stay beside you still
no words are needed in this room
only the warmth we know

Even as the seasons pass
this heart won't change its way

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Even if the night grows long
and the road feels far away
I'll be the quiet place
where your tired heart can stay

[Chorus]
I'll hold you with a wider heart
even the scars you hide
through the dark and silent nights
my light will stay for you

I'll stay beside the road you walk
until the morning comes
even at the edge of the world
I'll still be standing there

[Outro]
(piano instrumental outro, calm emotional fade)
